records.reason: Replace inconsistently wrapping benefit icons with a quiet text panel; align the form and improve field contrast. All authored screens and dependent setups rechecked; see template-six-refinements-2026-09-29 review.
records.action: Retain the refined composition. Recheck dependent setups on future edits.

records.reason: Remove decorative benefit icons, use a consistent editorial list and labelled full-width form, and strengthen field contrast. All authored screens and dependent setups rechecked; see template-six-refinements-2026-09-29 review.
records.action: Retain the refined composition. Recheck dependent setups on future edits.

records.reason: Remove unrelated benefit icons, use a compact text panel and strengthen field outlines and secondary copy. All authored screens and dependent setups rechecked; see template-six-refinements-2026-09-29 review.
records.action: Retain the refined composition. Recheck dependent setups on future edits.

records.reason: The lightning symbol does not explain shipping, returns or related reading.
records.action: Remove the generic icon and give the short heading/action their own compact spacing.

records.reason: Remove the unrelated delivery icon and use a responsive message/action split with clear spacing. All authored screens and dependent setups rechecked; see template-six-refinements-2026-09-29 review.
records.action: Retain the refined composition. Recheck dependent setups on future edits.

records.reason: The sample requests one guide but retains marketing-consent wording.
records.action: Align sample consent and privacy copy with a one-off resource request; retain meaningful merchant-editable imagery.

records.reason: The tall plant illustration is unrelated to the bakery sample and consumes much of the mobile card.
records.action: Use relevant shallow artwork or a complete text-only state. Review the consultation campaign with its actual copy too.

records.reason: At 320px the headline breaks into many short lines and pushes the form down.
records.action: Retune narrow heading size and padding; inspect the native overlay, dismissal and keyboard route.

records.reason: At 320px two heavily padded panels make a short guide request unnecessarily tall.
records.action: Reduce narrow panel padding and headline size, and keep request wording consistent across form and acknowledgement.

records.reason: The clearly labelled sample review still takes substantial space before the form; a merchant needs genuine evidence.
records.action: Shorten the proof area and provide a complete no-review state. Never publish fictional endorsements as real.

records.reason: The narrow sample and acknowledgement both devote substantial space to repeated product decoration.
records.action: Shorten the mobile product pane and simplify the acknowledgement while retaining product identity.

records.reason: The three topic tiles wrap as two plus one at 320px, weakening the ordered checklist.
records.action: Use one consistent narrow arrangement; check longer translated topic labels and actual campaign copy.

records.reason: The sample is long on phones and ends with an unnecessarily wide information-link button.
records.action: Tighten repetitive scope copy and use a content-width link; keep service limits understandable.

records.reason: Optional name plus topic and email make a tall phone request when the service introduction is long.
records.action: Test a compact narrow introduction; only request the optional name where it improves the reply.

records.reason: The abstract sample image does not explain the collection, while the returns claim needs merchant verification.
records.action: Provide useful original product artwork or remove the image; make the returns prerequisite explicit for new uses.

records.reason: The same popup structure and converting action recur with different styling and sample words.
records.action: Keep one sale composition as the future canonical base; first review Free/paid packaging and any dependents.

records.reason: Replace abstract placeholder with original product artwork, balance split panels, refine mobile hierarchy and strengthen field boundaries. All authored screens and dependent setups rechecked; see template-six-refinements-2026-09-29 review.
records.action: Compare content transfer and optional field support, then fold this into a variant instead of counting another visual direction.

records.reason: Both supply a quiet editorial signup row; rule and palette differences are weak grounds for two visual directions.
records.action: Preserve the preferred type treatment as a variant after checking existing use cases and copy transfer.

records.reason: Both build an invitation around a large number in a media pane beside a request column.
records.action: Keep both source files for now; evaluate a shared number-led family with editorial variants, not independent novelty claims.

records.reason: The simple email journey has no additional visible step beyond a standard form and acknowledgement.
records.action: Preserve its submission references and any dependent Playbooks when selecting one neutral email base.

records.reason: Use quieter warm colours, accessible field outlines, compact typography and request-specific copy with an optional name. All authored screens and dependent setups rechecked; see template-six-refinements-2026-09-29 review.
records.action: Check guide-purpose copy and role transfer before grouping under the neutral card; do not remove the optional-name capability.

references.name: Depicter: Horizontal Signup Form with Image
references.reviewed: Live desktop preview on 28 September; page availability rechecked on 29 September.
references.lesson: Balance a short form against imagery that explains the offer.
references.application: A useful object or excerpt should earn its space; keep visible field labels.

references.name: Depicter: Minimal Slide-in / Simple Abandonment
references.reviewed: Gallery thumbnails on 28 September; detail previews stalled.
references.lesson: One small contextual request, a short action and obvious dismissal.
references.application: Keep corner cards compact and relevant to the page. No unrelated gift or lightning icon.

references.name: Depicter: Early Cyber Week Notification Bar
references.reviewed: Live desktop preview on 28 September; page availability rechecked on 29 September.
references.lesson: A shallow row separates message, offer and action.
references.application: Reuse a good compact bar; do not invent urgency or claim a palette swap is a new design.
